body:
Rulify 1.7.0-beta.5
Windows 10/11 x64

Open the Windows installer and follow the prompts. Open Rulify from the Start menu.
To update, close Rulify and run the new installer. Your existing library and settings are kept.

- Rulify Beta now ships as a Windows installer.
- Play supported public YouTube tracks without an account or cookie import.

The installer is unsigned. The download page lists its SHA-256.
